This [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] '''[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]]''' served the [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Jerec (Inquisitor)|Jerec]] while [[Vengeance Battle Group]] occupied the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]] in [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]]. He led an inspection of the [[Transport/Legends|transport]] ''[[High Hauler]]'', which had arrived at the planet without the necessary recognition codes and was claiming to have a cargo of [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]] aboard.<ref name="JK" />

==History==
<!-- This narration assumes that the Officer hailing Hauler is the same person as the Lt. who inspects it; the audio drama suggests so -->
The Imperial Lieutenant was serving on Jerec's [[flagship/Legends|flagship]] ''[[Vengeance (Vengeance-class)|Vengeance]]'' in [[Ruusan system/Legends|Hoth's Brand system]] when a [[transport/Legends|transport]] exited [[hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] to the [[star system/Legends|star system]]. He hailed the ship demanding confirmation codes, but the acting captain had none, as he was actually an engineering officer assuming command after a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] attack; in reality they were [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[agent/Legends|agents]] who came to stop Jerec's operations on Ruusan.<ref name="JK" />

Although the Imperials initially threatened to destroy the ''High Hauler'', the mention of the proton torpedoes forced them to change their mind, as the group had half the needed ordnance. They dispatched a boarding party with the Lieutenant and some [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtroopers]] to inspect the ship's condition and secure the torpedoes, which, in fact, were defective and would explode in the launch tube if used.<ref name="JK" /><ref name="JK audio" />

He arrived to the ''High Hauler'' on an [[assault shuttle/Legends|assault shuttle]] docked to the bay and met with the acting captain "[[Alfonso Luiz Obota|Hortu Agar]]";<ref name="JK" /> Seeing the ship's condition, he believed the man's story and what they had been through, but pointed out that his groups is in a [[Search for the Valley of the Jedi|quest for the Valley of the Jedi|classified mission]] and off-limits.<ref name="JK audio">[[Dark Forces: Jedi Knight (audio drama)|''Dark Forces: Jedi Knight'' audio drama]]</ref>

In the following fourty-five [[standard minute/Legends|minutes]] a [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] with [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtroopers]] inspected the [[Bridge_(starship)/Legends|bridge]], the [[engine/Legends|engineering]] and the hull damage. Back to the bay, the Lieutenant inquired about the [[HWK-290_light_freighter/Legends|HWK-290 light freighter]] . Satisfied with "Agar"'s explanations, and concurring that everything in the Remnant is in short supply,<ref name="JK audio" /> the Lieutentant was ready to inspect the torpedoes before trans-shipping, but this boring task was skipped when the "[[Kyle Katarn|warrant officer]]" alerted that a [[lighter]] was ready to dock for transshipment. Twelve load lifter droids loaded the sabotaged torpedoes to the lighter, a process that took three trips.<ref name="JK" />

Before that, "Hortu Agar" requested to make necessary repairs to his vessel and dispatch the ''[[Moldy Crow/Legends|Moldy Crow]]'' on a series of errands: the delivery of spare parts, the securing of food rations, and a fictional training "mission"; the Lieutenant cleared the ship's [[Transponder code|transponder signal]] with flight control on the ''Vengeance'', which allowed the two agents [[Kyle Katarn]] and [[Jan Ors]] to pass through Ruusan's heavily guarded northern hemisphere.
<ref name="JK">''[[Dark Forces: Jedi Knight]]''</ref><ref name="JK audio" />

==Personality and traits==
According to Obota, the Lieutenant seemed a person whom he would find likeable and friendly in different conditions. The Lieutenant showed sympathy for the ''Hauler''{{'s}} story and showed his relief for reaching them after what they thought they had been through. This allowed Obota to scam him; even when he said the story of having acquired the ''Moldy Crow'' after losing a shuttle some time ago, the Lieutenant lamented that everything was in short supply.<ref name="JK" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Lieutenant appears as an unnamed character in the novella ''[[Dark Forces: Jedi Knight]]'' and there is a shorter dialogue of him with Obota in [[Dark Forces: Jedi Knight (audio drama)|the audio adaptation]]. Other than that, there is a slight difference in timing; whereas in the novella he notices the ''Crow'' shortly before leaving, in the audio drama he notices it shortly before arriving.

[[Peter Moore]] is credited as "Officer" in the audio drama.
